title: Sulfurization and anneal run
summary: Sulfurization at 700 °C for 10 min, argon flush, and 900 °C anneal for 5 min of a FIB-irradiated MoSe₂ chip on the split-tube furnace, following the lab's operating notes. Ramp rates, pressures, flow rates and endpoints are the lab's established settings.

steps.title: Prepare the cooling system
steps.body: Set up the ice bath for the cooling-water reservoir, start circulation, and confirm that cooling is working.

steps.title: Check the argon supply
steps.body: Verify the supply pressure and connections. Your noted above-5-psi reading refers to the supply check, not a tube-pressure target; confirm the gauge with the furnace operator.
steps.caution: The above-5-psi reading is a supply check, not a tube-pressure target.

steps.title: Purge the tube before loading
steps.body: With the tube sealed, use the approved valve arrangement for evacuation and backfilling. Your notes specify isolating the fume-hood outlet during these exchanges. Evacuate the tube, isolate the vacuum line, admit argon to the approved backfill pressure, close the argon inlet, and evacuate again. Complete three purge cycles, using the established pressure endpoints.
steps.check: Three purge cycles completed to the established endpoints

steps.title: Prepare to open the tube
steps.body: Confirm that the furnace is cool and heating is disabled. Equalize the tube pressure using the equipment procedure before releasing any connection.

steps.title: Open the furnace and withdraw the holder
steps.body: Open the clamshell cover, remove or retract the thermocouple as required, and withdraw the sample assembly toward the right.

steps.title: Load the sulfur and sample
steps.body: Place the sulfur in a quartz boat and position the chip beside it. Your proposed 1–2 g sulfur charge is a local setting that needs confirmation; the paper does not specify a mass.
steps.caution: The 1–2 g sulfur charge is a local setting to confirm; the paper does not specify a mass.

steps.title: Reassemble the system
steps.body: Return the holder, reinstall the thermocouple in its designated position, seal the tube, and check the connections.

steps.title: Re-establish the processing atmosphere
steps.body: Perform the lab's post-loading evacuation and argon-backfill procedure to remove the air introduced during loading. Set the valves to the approved heating configuration, then close the furnace cover.
steps.check: Post-loading purge done, valves in the approved heating configuration, cover closed

steps.title: Sulfurize the sample
steps.body: Heat to 700 °C using the established ramp rate. Once the target temperature is reached, hold for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove sulfur vapor
steps.body: Flush the chamber with argon through the approved exhaust route. Use the established flow rate and flushing endpoint before increasing the temperature.
steps.caution: Do not raise the temperature until the flushing endpoint is reached.

steps.title: Anneal the sample
steps.body: Increase the temperature to 900 °C and hold for 5 minutes, maintaining the required gas conditions.

steps.title: Cool down
steps.body: Cool to room temperature while maintaining the required gas conditions and cooling-water circulation.

steps.title: Retrieve the sample
steps.body: Equalize the tube pressure according to the equipment procedure, open the assembly, retract the thermocouple as needed, and remove the chip.
steps.caution: Never release a connection before the pressure is equalized.
steps.check: Furnace cool, heating disabled, tube pressure equalized

steps.title: Record and shut down
steps.body: Record the temperature program, sulfur mass, purge conditions, and argon-flow settings. Shut down the equipment in the prescribed order.
